tool_input.command:
cd "C:/visual projects/role-play-vibing/.claude/worktrees/tk011" && ls .claude/dispatcher/stop.py 2>&1 | head -1; cat > "$(cygpath -u "$TEMP")/tk011_stop.py" <<'EOF'
import re
from pathlib import Path
DD = Path(".claude/dispatcher")
disp = DD / "dispatch.py"
src = disp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
lines = src.splitlines(keepends=True)
# блок: от def _poll_running до конца process_stop_requests (по тексту)
a = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("def _poll_running("))
b = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("def _apply_header_updates("))
# подкомментарий-раздел перед write_stop_request остаётся внутри блока
block = "".join(lines[a:b]).rstrip("\n") + "\n"
# внедряемые зависимости
subs = {
    "_poll_running": ("poll_running", ["running", "proc_alive", "kill_proc", "finish_run", "run_timeout"],
                      {"RUNNING": "running", "_proc_alive": "proc_alive", "_kill_proc": "kill_proc", "_finish_run": "finish_run", "RUN_TIMEOUT": "run_timeout"}),
    "recover_active_runs": ("recover_active_runs", ["running", "finish_run", "proc_start", "pid_alive"],
                      {"RUNNING": "running", "_finish_run": "finish_run", "_proc_start": "proc_start", "_pid_alive": "pid_alive"}),
    "process_stop_requests": ("process_stop_requests", ["running", "stop_run", "finish_run", "append_ceo_inbox"],
                      {"RUNNING": "running", "_stop_run": "stop_run", "_finish_run": "finish_run", "append_ceo_inbox": "append_ceo_inbox"}),
}
import ast
tree = ast.parse(block)
bl = block.splitlines(keepends=True)
out = []
pos = 0
for n in tree.body:
    if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in subs:
        new, params, mp = subs[n.name]
        s = n.lineno - 1; e = n.end_lineno
        seg = "".join(bl[s:e])
        for k, v in mp.items():
            seg = re.sub(rf"(?<![\w.]){re.escape(k)}\b", v, seg)
        m = re.match(r"def \w+\(([^)]*)\)", seg)
        seg = seg.replace(m.group(0), f"def {new}({m.group(1)}, {', '.join(params)})", 1)
        out.append((s, e, seg))
res = []
cur = 0
for s, e, seg in out:
    res.append("".join(bl[cur:s])); res.append(seg); cur = e
res.append("".join(bl[cur:]))
body = "".join(res)
head = '''"""Остановка роли и подхват запусков: заявки `tickets.py stop`, опрос идущих запусков, подхват после перезапуска.

Вынесено из dispatch.py (TK-011). Зависимости от запусков и процессов (RUNNING, _finish_run, _kill_proc…) передаются
параметрами — подставляют обёртки в dispatch.py, поэтому подмена имён на dispatch в тестах работает как раньше."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import config as CFG  # noqa: E402
import project as P  # noqa: E402
import ticket as T  # noqa: E402


'''
body = body.replace("def _poll_running(", "def poll_running(")
(DD / "stop.py").write_text(head + body, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
# dispatch: заменить блок обёртками
wrappers = '''from stop import (  # noqa: E402,F401 — остановка и подхват запусков вынесены в stop.py; здесь обёртки подставляют идущие запуски
    write_stop_request, _stop_requests, _reset_loop_state, _apply_stop, _find_pid_by_session)


def _poll_running(state: dict, now) -> None:
    STOP.poll_running(state, now, RUNNING, _proc_alive, _kill_proc, _finish_run, RUN_TIMEOUT)


def recover_active_runs(state: dict, now) -> None:
    STOP.recover_active_runs(state, now, RUNNING, _finish_run, _proc_start, _pid_alive)


def process_stop_requests(state: dict, now) -> None:
    STOP.process_stop_requests(state, now, RUNNING, _stop_run, _finish_run, append_ceo_inbox)


'''
new = "".join(lines[:a]) + wrappers + "".join(lines[b:])
new = new.replace("import signals as SIG  # noqa: E402\n", "import signals as SIG  # noqa: E402\nimport stop as STOP  # noqa: E402\n", 1)
disp.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
EOF
python "$(cygpath -u "$TEMP")/tk011_stop.py" && wc -l .claude/dispatcher/dispatch.py .claude/dispatcher/stop.py && git diff --stat
